Namespace fw: — https://cubits11.github.io/ns/falsifiable/v1/# Version 1

A JSON-LD vocabulary

14 properties for a claim and its qualifications

Schema.org can express that a document contains a claim. It cannot express the observation that would withdraw the claim, what the author has undertaken to do when that observation arrives, or which repairs the author has declared unavailable in advance. Those are the properties this site needs, so this site defines them.

01What this is not

This is not a standard. It is one publisher's vocabulary, versioned, with exactly one implementation — the 21 claim pages on this site. It is published because a JSON-LD prefix that does not resolve is a prefix nobody can check, not because anyone else has adopted it.

Custom properties do not promise a search enhancement or enforce quotation. They make the qualifications available beside the proposition. A consumer can still ignore or omit them; this vocabulary does not prevent that.

02The terms

  • fw:falsifierText

    The stated condition that triggers the declared consequence.

    SOURCE · falsifier.condition

  • fw:consequenceText

    The declared response: NARROW, REJECT or HOLD.

    SOURCE · falsifier.consequence

  • fw:forbiddenRescueText list

    Repairs the author declares unavailable after the falsifier fires.

    An explicit empty RDF list preserves the difference between no forbidden rescues and an omitted field.

    SOURCE · forbidden_rescues

  • fw:nonClaimText list

    Limits the author states on what the claim licenses.

    SOURCE · non_claims

  • fw:scopeStatementText

    The claim's stated domain and limitations.

    SOURCE · scope

  • fw:evidentialStatusText

    The registry's current evidential-status label.

    SOURCE · dimensions.evidential_status

  • fw:lastReviewedDate

    The last review date recorded for this claim.

    SOURCE · last_reviewed

  • fw:reviewWindowDuration

    The declared interval between required reviews.

    SOURCE · review_window_days

  • fw:warrantExpiresDate

    The recorded review date plus the review window.

    After this date the review is overdue. This is not a probability, a truth verdict, or proof that no unrecorded review occurred.

    SOURCE · last_reviewed + review_window_days

  • fw:supportUrlURL

    The declared public support location, which may be mutable.

    SOURCE · support.url

  • fw:supportBindingURL

    A support URL containing the declared immutable revision.

    Emitted only with a declared revision embedded in the URL. Reachability and other binding checks belong to verify_claims.py; this metadata alone proves neither.

    SOURCE · support.url, when support.commit is embedded

  • fw:boundRevisionText

    The immutable support revision declared in the registry.

    SOURCE · support.commit

  • fw:verdictText

    An explicit rejection notice recorded at the start of the proposition.

    SOURCE · proposition rejection prefix

  • fw:verdictDateDate

    The date of that explicit rejection notice.

    SOURCE · proposition rejection prefix

03Use

Use the published context alongside schema.org. JSON-LD consumers can preserve the custom properties; applications decide whether to interpret them:

{
  "@context": [
    "https://schema.org",
    "https://cubits11.github.io/ns/falsifiable/v1/context.json"
  ],
  "@type": "Claim",
  "identifier": "CC-004",
  "text": "For marginals (0.10, 0.10) and the both-fail query, cc.kernel.strict identify() returns the sharp interval [0.0, 0.10] together with endpoint witness distributions that sum to one, are nonnegative, satisfy both marginal constraints, and attain each endpoint — verified to 1e-9 from a clean clone.",
  "fw:falsifier": "Bound identify() execution fails any stated interval, witness feasibility constraint, marginal constraint, or endpoint-attainment assertion at the declared tolerance.",
  "fw:consequence": "REJECT",
  "fw:forbiddenRescue": [
    "do not replace a failed endpoint witness with an interior distribution or a loose approximate candidate",
    "do not waive a failed sum, nonnegativity, marginal, or attainment constraint by changing the tolerance after the outcome"
  ],
  "fw:nonClaim": [
    "endpoint witnesses are feasible mathematical worlds, not observed systems",
    "attainment does not select a point inside the interval or estimate the true dependence"
  ],
  "fw:warrantExpires": "2026-12-22"
}

The context document: /ns/falsifiable/v1/context.json. Both it and this page are generated from the same constants that render the claim pages, so a term cannot be defined here and emitted differently there.

04Stability

Version 1 terms will not change meaning under this URL. A term whose meaning has to change gets a new version path. A term that turns out to be unused gets deleted from version 2 and stays resolvable at version 1, because a namespace that breaks its own old documents teaches publishers not to use namespaces.
